result:
I’d make genuine empathy a social default—people would pause to understand what others are experiencing before deciding who is right or wrong.

Not agreement, just recognition. Most cruelty begins when someone else’s humanity becomes invisible. Changing that would quietly reshape conversations, relationships, institutions, and conflicts more than any single policy could.
